_about: Where Michigan ballot data comes from. tools/import/run.mjs reads this, downloads each official list and writes data/ballots/MI/<election>/. To add a county: add its clerk's Official Candidate List PDF URL here (most Michigan counties publish the same report). 'colleges' says which part of the county votes in each community-college race; 'wardMaps' links each city's ward map for the ward picker.

statewide.note: The Bureau of Elections' statewide certified list, as republished by the Calhoun County Clerk.
